thread:
Alex: heading out for the night, passing handoff. Current hot items below — please read first msg and ack if you take primary. TL;DR: eu-west rate-shedding + cache eviction spike affecting some low-latency tenant requests. I'm primary until 3532105400, then Priya will take over.

Alex: Active alerts:
- svc-rate-shed-eu (pager) — traffic > burst_policy, shed ratio ~12% p95 of now.
- kv-evict-eu (warning) — evictions up 4x last 30m, memory pressure on r5k-cache-3.
- prefetch-queue-length (alert) — backlog grow on embeddings prefetch queue (consumer lag ~7m).

OpsBot: :rotating_light: Alert svc-rate-shed-eu triggered at 3532102001. Pager sent to @oncall.

Marco: ack. I'm on deck for fallback routing and can own the rate-shed mitigation if needed.

Alex: thanks Marco. Current mitigations in progress:
- Autoscaler bump: increased eu-west reserved workers by +2 (deployed 3532102300).
- Temporary shed adjustments: moved some low-priority routes to burst-fallback (canary) at 3532102700.
- Applying cache pinning patch to policy for ACME-9 customer to reduce churn (in progress, job 9442).

Jamie: checking logs now. Seeing repeated KV TTL evictions on r5k-cache-3; pattern looks like prefetch churn + small items expiring. Might help to increase prefetch rate for embeddings for 15m.

Priya: I'll take primary at 3532105400. If anything escalates after that, page me. Planning to watch p95 + redis evict rates.

Alex: runbook links (please follow):
- Rate shedding playbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rate-shedding (see step 2 -> rotate-traffic).
- KV eviction mitigation: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-evictions (prefetch tuning section).
- Fallback routing: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/fallback-routing (canary -> full swap).

Alex: examples of commands I used:
```bash
# bump reserved pool
redwood infra capacity update --region eu-west --pool serving --add 2 --reason "handoff bump"
# route low-priority to fallback
redwood routing set-route --route low-prio --target fallback-canary --weight 30
```

Marco: i've started a controlled canary increase for routing to fallback-canary; weight +10 at 3532103005. Watching error rates. So far no spikes on p50 but p95 improved slightly.

OpsBot: Bridge created for thread: https://bridge.redwood/room/hand-off-3532101234 by OncallBridge at 3532103050.

Alex: customer impact:
- ACME-9 and BetaCorp may see 5-15% increased latency on specific prompt families. No total outage. Tickets opened by support: #SUP-1423 and #SUP-1424.

Jamie: quick note — logs show a malformed prefetch job for tenant BetaCorp at 3532102900 which churned keys, contributing to evictions. I rolled a patch to reject malformed payloads; it's in canary (job 9445).

Priya: acked. Primary handoff in ~45m. My immediate play if shed goes >25% is to trigger circuit-breaker for non-PLG routes and increase reserved workers by +4. Will coordinate with Marco for routing.

Alex: handing over followups:
- Priya -> primary at 3532105400.
- Marco -> secondary for routing/fallback.
- Jamie -> support with logs and prefetch tuning.
- If alarm svc-rate-shed-eu hits severity 2 (pager escalation) -> escalate to Eng SEV channel and call SRE leads.

Priya: noted. I'll be online and will join the bridge. If you leave, have a good night, Alex.

Alex: thanks team. leaving now. Callout: check p95 at 3532106000 and evictions every 5m. I'm reachable via phone if needed. :wave:

OncallBridge: transfer note — primary now set to Priya at 3532105400, secondary Marco.

Priya: I'm primary now. Quick status: rate-shed ~10%, evictions trending down after prefetch patch. Keeping bridge open. Taking ownership of communications to support.

Marco: i'm monitoring routing. Can increase fallback weight to 50 if Priya wants to reduce tail latency immediately.

Priya: hold at current steps for 10m while we watch metrics. If p95 > 600ms or shed >20% we proceed to fallback weight +40 and reserved +4.

Jamie: will follow up with support notes for ACME-9 and BetaCorp, documenting mitigation and ETA for full fix.

Priya: thanks. Passing to next night coverage — @Jamie, can you be primary for late-night if I need to hand off at 3532110000?

Jamie: yep i can. I'll watch the bridge and be ready to take over.

Priya: last check-in: p95 420ms, shed 9%, evict rate down 60% from peak. Closing ring for now but will update if anything changes.

OncallBridge: thread closed for transfer at 3532110456.
